structure.dashboard: Single page layout. Top: Header (Logo + Actions). Middle: Metrics Grid (4 cols). Bottom: Data Table.
structure.mobile: Stack metrics vertically. Table scrollable horizontally.

metric_card.style: bg-[#0A0A0F] border border-white/10 rounded-xl p-6 hover:border-primary/30 transition-colors
metric_card.content_structure: Label (text-sm text-muted) -> Value (text-3xl font-mono text-white) -> Trend/Icon (optional)

status_badge.paid: bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-500 border border-emerald-500/20 px-2 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-medium
status_badge.pending: bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-500 border border-amber-500/20 px-2 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-medium
status_badge.failed: bg-red-500/10 text-red-500 border border-red-500/20 px-2 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-medium

filters.input: bg-[#0A0A0F] border-white/10 text-sm h-9 rounded-md focus:ring-primary

visual_enhancers.glows: Use subtle primary glows behind key metrics or active states.
visual_enhancers.gradients: Avoid full gradients. Use subtle radial gradients for backgrounds only.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use a simple password protection mechanism (e.g., a hardcoded check or simple env var check) before showing the dashboard.
Fetch data from the backend (FastAPI) which connects to MongoDB.
Use the existing Shadcn UI components in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/ where possible, but style them to match the 'Cyber-Executive' theme.
Ensure the 'Leads Table' supports filtering by Date Range, Payment Status, and UTM Source.
Implement the 'CSV Export' feature to download the table data.
Auto-refresh the stats every 30 seconds or provide a refresh button.
Use 'JetBrains Mono' for all monetary values and counts to emphasize the data-first approach.
CRITICAL: Ensure the background is #050508 and not a generic gray.
CRITICAL: Do not use 'Inter' for the main numbers; use the mono font.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur)
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
